network_status.network: Strambino: crollato il vecchio ponte sul Chiusella
network_status.summary_it: La cronaca documenta erosione progressiva dell'alveo, fondazioni della pila centrale già danneggiate e chiusura preventiva del ponte prima del cedimento. Non identifica una piena evento-specifica il 15 giugno 2017 né pubblica idrometria: il degrado idraulico cumulativo resta distinto da un colmo osservato.
network_status.summary_en: The account documents progressive channel erosion, already damaged central-pier foundations and precautionary closure before failure. It identifies neither an event-specific flood on 15 June 2017 nor hydrometry, so cumulative hydraulic degradation remains distinct from an observed peak.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
